definitions.explanation: The quality of being morally right and fair; adherence to moral principles.

examples.japanese: {正義|せいぎ}のために{戦|たたか}う。
{正義|せいぎ}は{必|かなら}ず{勝|か}つ。
{彼|かれ}は{正義感|せいぎかん}が{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: He has a strong sense of justice.

notes:
{正義|せいぎ} refers to justice or righteousness — the principle of moral correctness and fairness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正義|せいぎ}のために: for the sake of justice
- {正義感|せいぎかん}: sense of justice
- {正義|せいぎ}の{味方|みかた}: ally of justice, champion of the right
- {社会|しゃかい}{正義|せいぎ}: social justice
- {正義|せいぎ}を{貫|つらぬ}く: to uphold justice

USAGE:
{正義|せいぎ}の{味方|みかた} is a set phrase common in anime, manga, and superhero contexts (similar to 'defender of justice'). {正義感|せいぎかん}が{強|つよ}い describes someone with a strong sense of right and wrong.

RELATED WORDS:
- {公正|こうせい}: fairness, impartiality (objective, procedural)
- {倫理|りんり}: ethics (philosophical, systematic)
- {道徳|どうとく}: morality (personal, taught values)
